text:
incident-bot: Paging: High p95 latency / throughput degradation observed for inference region eu-west-1. Alerting oncall.

dave_oncall: On it. Seeing elevated queue lengths on router-2 and increased tail latency for 1k+ requests/min. Investigating routing and backend saturation. Anyone: recent deploys? :thinking_face:

alex_engineering: No infra deploys in last 30m. We did a model autoscaler tweak earlier today but that was ~3h ago. Looking at metrics now.

jen_sre: I can see one of the routing pools (rtr-eu-2) hitting 90% CPU and OOM churn on the sidecars. KV-cache hit rate dropped ~15% coincident with latency spike.

maria_prodops: Customer impact? Any specific tenants affected or is this noisy neighbor across many? Need to prepare status page copy.

liz_support: Support queue: 3 customers reported slow responses in last 12 minutes, all in EU. Two are APM logs customers showing 2-3x token latency.

dave_oncall: Thanks. Immediate mitigations: 1) route traffic away from rtr-eu-2 -> rtr-eu-1, rtr-eu-3 (manual routing rule). 2) roll back autoscaler change for model pool eu-gen-2 to previous min_replicas. 3) enable degraded-mode fallback to smaller quantized model for non-enterprise tiers. I'm going to run routing change now.

deploy-bot: reroute-request submitted: from=rtr-eu-2 to=[rtr-eu-1,rtr-eu-3] scope=production by=dave_oncall

deploy-bot: reroute-complete: 2 nodes drained, traffic shifted. (task id 0x7c2)

alex_engineering: Rolling back autoscaler: patch applied to eu-gen-2 config (min_replicas: 6 -> 12). Triggering scale up.

jen_sre: Observability note: enabling prefix KV-cache backfill for eu-gen-2 - there was a stale invalidation. Backfilling now should help tail latency as KV hit recovers.

dave_oncall: Enabling degraded-mode fallback for non-enterprise routes. Policy: requests with tier!=enterprise will get model eu-lite-quant for sequences >1024. Doing a 5-min canary.

maria_prodops: Draft status page update for engineers/customers — please review and approve quickly:

"Status: Performance degradation in EU (eu-west-1)

We are investigating increased request latency and reduced throughput impacting some inference requests in the EU region. We have rerouted traffic from an affected routing pool, rolled back a recent autoscaler change, and enabled a temporary degraded fallback to a smaller model for non-enterprise customers. We expect traffic to stabilize within 10-20 minutes. We will post updates every 15 minutes or as we have new information."

liz_support: Good. Add note: "No data loss; requests may be slower or served by a lower-cost model." Customers appreciate clarity on data integrity.

dave_oncall: Agreed, add that line. Also add: "Enterprise customers on dedicated capacity may not be affected if pinned to dedicated pools. If you see ongoing issues, reply to your incident contact or open a ticket."

maria_prodops: Updated status page text approved. Alex / Jen - can you confirm ETA for recovery?

alex_engineering: After routing and scale changes, p95 is trending down from 1.8s to 950ms. Throughput still ramping. ETA ~12 minutes to normal for most traffic if no new regressions.

jen_sre: KV cache hit rate at +8% since backfill started, OOM churn reduced after draining rtr-eu-2. If we see re-occurrence, we'll escalate to infra to reprovision an extra routing node group.

dave_oncall: Posting status now and pinging SRE lead for potential infra reprovision: @jen_sre and @infra-lead for visibility. I'll keep thread updated.

incident-bot: status_page_update posted: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/3123456789

liz_support: Noted. I've prepared a short customer-facing email for affected accounts — ready to send once we confirm stabilization.

maria_prodops: Good work. Let's follow up after 15 minutes with final recovery note and root-cause plan for the postmortem. Prep comms template for customers who ask for details.

alex_engineering: One quick log snippet from rtr-eu-2 showing memory churn:

```
2026-03-15T12:34:10Z rtr-eu-2 sidecar: mem_usage=78% -> 96% in 120s, gc_pause=0.8s
2026-03-15T12:34:11Z rtr-eu-2 router: queue_len=320 -> 900
```

jen_sre: Copying logs to incident bucket and starting retention capture. We'll attach to postmortem.

dave_oncall: Final: p95 now ~620ms, KV hit ~+12%, requests served by fallback ~7% of non-enterprise. Marking as "mitigated" in 10m unless regression. Great cross-team response — thanks all. :raised_hands:

incident-bot: incident-mitigated: thread marked mitigated by dave_oncall at 3123456805
